title: Partners
subtitle: Who invested what, who holds the cash, salaries and the 50/50 profit split
scopeNote: Investments, cash held and payables are all-time balances. Cash collected, salaries and profit follow the selected period.

empty.title: No partners set up yet
empty.hint: Add the partners as money holders in Settings to see investments, cash held and the profit split here.

invested.title: Total invested
invested.note: Joint = rental income put into spare parts. Profit split 50/50.
invested.emptyHint: Units and purchases paid personally by a partner, and cash injections, appear here automatically.

whoPaid.title: Who paid for what
whoPaid.description: Personal investments per partner by category

collected.title: Cash collected by
collected.description: Money received per holder in the selected period
collected.empty: No money collected in this period

holding.title: Currently holding
holding.description: Money received but not yet handed over to the company account
holding.overdueHint: Held longer than {{days}} days — please settle
holding.datesError: Settlement dates could not be loaded.

salaries.title: Salaries
salaries.description: Monthly rate at the end of the period and the total for the period
salaries.emptyHint: Partner salaries are deducted from the profit before the 50/50 split.

profit.title: Profit
profit.description: Net profit for the period, salaries deducted, then split 50/50
profit.howCalculated: How the net profit is calculated
profit.noPartners: No active partners to split the profit between.
profit.taxNote: Estimate only — the accountant confirms the final tax.

payables.title: Company owes partners
payables.note: Display only — repayments to partners are not tracked here.
